name: Subtitles and Maps
author: Wasi Master
description: Shows subtitle and lyric files and GPS tracks in the keyboard's file manager. Subtitles (SRT, WebVTT, ASS and SSA) and synced lyrics (LRC) appear as a list of lines with their times. Tracks and routes (GPX, KML, GeoJSON, TCX) show their shape, distance, time, climb and an elevation chart, plus their named places.
